articles.summary: New division combines wealth management, investment program support, institutional consulting, and balance sheet resources for community depositories Momentum Independent Network Inc. (MIN), a member of the Hilltop Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HTH) family of companies and an affiliate of Hilltop Securities Inc. (HilltopSecurities), has announced the launch of Momentum Financial Institution Services (MFIS). articles.title: Momentum Independent Network Launches Momentum Financial Institution Services to Support Community Banks and Credit Unions
